summary: Tested two bug fixes: (1) Weekly income calculation now uses calendar-based weekday count via count_weekday_occurrences instead of fixed 4.33 multiplier, and (2) Wizard form state resets when entering a new module via resetModuleState function. All backend tests pass (10/10). Frontend labels verified: 'Expected Monthly Income', 'adjusted to monthly', 'Fixed (this month)', 'Variable (this month)', '/mo' suffix on cards.

weekly_income_calendar_based_calculation.details: Weekly income now uses count_weekday_occurrences function. For a 25K weekly income on Friday, monthlyTotal equals 25K * (number of Fridays in current month), NOT 25K * 4.33

weekly_income_received_pending_calendar_.details: monthlyReceived and monthlyPending use actual date-based occurrences (e.g., if 3 Fridays passed, received=75K, pending=25K)

weekly_income_no_selected_day_defaults_t.details: When selectedDay is empty, backend defaults to createdAt weekday instead of using 4.33 multiplier

monthly_income_unaffected.details: Monthly income calculation remains as-is (monthlyTotal equals expectedAmount)

monthly_summary_uses_calendar_weeks.details: /api/income/monthly-summary correctly uses count_weekday_occurrences for weekly income

income_detail_uses_calendar_weeks.details: /api/income/{id}/detail correctly uses count_weekday_occurrences for weekly income

frontend_expected_monthly_income_label.details: MyBusiness page shows 'Expected Monthly Income' header (data-testid='total-income-card')

frontend_adjusted_to_monthly_subtitle.details: MyBusiness page shows 'adjusted to monthly' subtitle under business count

frontend_fixed_this_month_label.details: MyBusiness page shows 'Fixed (this month)' label in header card

frontend_variable_this_month_label.details: MyBusiness page shows 'Variable (this month)' label in header card

frontend_mo_suffix_on_cards.details: Fixed/Variable cards show '/mo' suffix on totals

wizard_state_reset_implemented.details: resetModuleState function (line 157) clears all form fields when entering a new module. Called in useEffect when targetModule changes (line 195)

wizard_state_reset_assets_module.details: setAssetItems resets to [{ name: '', amount: '', type: 'bank_balance', ... }] when entering assets module

wizard_state_reset_investments_module.details: setInvestItems resets to [{ name: '', amount: '', type: 'mutual-fund', ... }] when entering investments module

critical_code_review_comments: count_weekday_occurrences function in routes/utils.py (line 138) correctly counts weekday occurrences in a month
Weekly income calculation in income.py uses count_weekday_occurrences at lines 141-145, 312-316, 572-575
When selectedDay is empty, code defaults to createdAt weekday (lines 129-140 in income.py)
resetModuleState in ProfileSetup.js (line 157) properly clears all module-specific state
useEffect at line 190-205 ensures resetModuleState is called when module changes
No 4.33 multiplier found anywhere in income.py or utils.py
seed_data_creation: Test income entries created with TEST_ prefix and auto-cleaned after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Weekly income calculation verified to use calendar-based count_weekday_occurrences. Wizard state reset verified via code review - resetModuleState function clears all form fields when entering a new module. MyBusiness page labels all correct.
